description: Operator CLI over the Ganglion console routes (docs/tasks/cli_operator.md)
epilog:
addressing:
  Most commands take their catalog / model / run from the context instead of a
  flag. Set it once:

    ganglion use --catalog iot_light_5 --model rules
    ganglion run list
    ganglion ask "거실 불 켜줘"

  Resolution per field is flag > environment > .ganglion/context.json > default.

output:
  --json   the /api/* payload verbatim (the machine contract)
  --jsonl  one JSON object per row

common_flags.help: author recorded on writes ($GANGLION_LABELER, else operator)
print one JSON object per row

nouns.help: join two runs of one catalog on case_id

leaves.help: POST /api/sessions — open a run bundle and save it to the context
leaves.description: Create a chat session for the context's catalog + model. The session_id and run_id are written to .ganglion/context.json, so the next `ganglion ask` and `ganglion trace list` address this run with no flags.
leaves.usage: ganglion session new [-h] [--runs DIR] [--models PATH] [--catalog ID] [--model ID] [--session ID] [--run ID] [--labeler NAME] [--json | --jsonl] [--repair] [--repair-max-attempts N]

print one JSON object per row
enable the M4 repair loop for this session / prompt

leaves.help: POST /api/sessions (if needed) then /api/chat — one prompt, F⁰/Fᴷ pair
leaves.description: Serve one prompt and print the F⁰/Fᴷ pair: the plan the catalog accepted next to the plan the model produced alone. Exits 1 when the model produced no valid plan — the trace is still recorded, so the printed trace_id is labellable either way. This is the only command that calls two routes: a session is created first when none is resolvable from --session / the context, or with --new-session.
leaves.usage: ganglion ask [-h] [--runs DIR] [--models PATH] [--catalog ID] [--model ID] [--session ID] [--run ID] [--labeler NAME] [--json | --jsonl] [--new-session] [--repair] [--repair-max-attempts N] [--raw] PROMPT [PROMPT ...]

environment.name: GANGLION_CATALOG
environment.what: default catalog_id, as --catalog would set it

environment.name: GANGLION_CTL_MODEL
environment.what: default registry model_id, as --model would set it

environment.name: GANGLION_RUNS
environment.what: runs-bundle root, as --runs would set it (default: runs/traces)

environment.name: GANGLION_MODELS
environment.what: registry yaml path; the registry's own resolution, shared with --models

environment.name: GANGLION_LABELER
environment.what: author recorded on every label and patch decision (default: operator)

environment.name: GANGLION_CONSOLE_URL
environment.what: loopback HTTP console URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8766; when set, use the running server instead of creating an in-process API

environment.name: GANGLION_PII_CHECKPOINT
environment.what: native PII checkpoint directory (default: runs/pii/qwen-0.8b-v2); read by the process that owns ProgramService

environment.name: GANGLION_PII_CANDIDATE_CHECKPOINT
environment.what: candidate PII checkpoint directory (default: runs/pii/qwen-0.8b-candidates-v1); read by the process that owns ProgramService

environment.name: GANGLION_PII_CANDIDATE_FALLBACK_CHECKPOINT
environment.what: optional fallback directory; must match the candidate checkpoint's fingerprinted source encoder
